caption: The drawing shows a hand holding a large brown bell. The hand is depicted in a naturalistic style, with visible fingernails and shading that accentuates the knuckles and fingers, and the skin tone is a light beige. The wrist and lower arm are clothed in a dark, blackish sleeve that appears to be part of a coat or uniform with faint lines suggesting sewing seams. The base of the arm cuts through a horizontal, rectangular black bar at the bottom of the image, which looks flat and features subtle wood grain textures. The background is a plain off-white color with several orange-brown stains or marks scattered across the paper. There is some small handwritten text near the bottom right corner.
title: Bell in Hand Tavern Sign
